rationale: A campaign-level cap bounds cumulative recovery spend across retries and physical executions. Its name is concise, expresses the limit, and states exact integer units; keeping it here avoids duplicating per-run caps.
alternatives: remove: would leave retry recovery without a campaign-wide cost bound
rename to recovery_spend_cap_microusd: redundant because recovery_policy already supplies that scope
simplestChoice: Keep as an optional non-negative integer.
